description: Python reference outputs on synthetic geographic source rasters: D29 resampled grids, nu per lag and direction, ln nu, H or its reason, supported lags and valid fraction. Null marks an unavailable value, never 0; ln nu is null where nu is null or 0.
sha256_rule: sha256 of each input as little-endian IEEE 754 float64 values in row-major order

distance_m: aeqd_cases[].inverse.lon_rad as radius_m * cos(lat) * |dlon|, dlon taken modulo 2 pi

exact_fields: every mask, count, reason, label, offset and null is compared exactly
